name: dsh-codearts-auth
description: deepseek-harness plugin: CodeArts (Huawei Cloud) browser login, storing the temporary credential via ctx.credentials

scripts.test:e2e:buddy: cross-env DSH_BUDDY_E2E=1 DSH_BUDDY_E2E_CONFIRM=yes vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/buddy-models.e2e.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:buddy-cache: cross-env DSH_BUDDY_E2E=1 DSH_BUDDY_E2E_CONFIRM=yes vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/buddy-cache-probe.e2e.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:buddy-probe: cross-env DSH_BUDDY_PROBE=1 vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/buddy-login-probe.e2e.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:buddy-pool: cross-env DSH_BUDDY_POOL_E2E=1 DSH_BUDDY_POOL_E2E_CONFIRM=yes vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/buddy-pool-probe.e2e.spec.ts
